description: This file defines a mock class 'TestModuleMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule'. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for testing IPC-related functionalities in the Rialto project, including methods for handling protobuf RPC calls and generating response objects.

classes.name: TestModuleMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' used in unit testing IPC interactions within the Rialto project.

methods.name: defaultReturn
methods.description: Simulates a successful RPC call by invoking the 'done' callback's Run method.

methods.name: failureReturn
methods.description: Simulates a failed RPC call by setting the controller's failure state and invoking the 'done' callback.

methods.name: getSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestSingleVar' protobuf message with 'var1' set to the provided value.

methods.name: getMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestMultiVar' protobuf message with fields set to the provided parameters.
